headline: Myriam Agbanglanon Adotevi: "SUNU Investment Holding's ambition is to become a leading banking player in West Africa"
summary: SUNU Investment Holding chief Myriam Agbanglanon Adotevi said the group aims to become a leading banking player in West Africa. Its two banks in Senegal and Togo hold total assets of about FCFA 1,000 billion.
why: SUNU is a regional banking group, and its growth plans affect lending to small and medium-sized businesses in West Africa.
original_headline: Myriam Agbanglanon Adotevi : «l’ambition de SUNU Investment Holding  est de devenir un acteur bancaire de référence en Afrique de l’Ouest »
